        iNeuOS_Vision平台模型适配食品加工、电力运维、油气管道、钢铁冶金、矿山煤炭、机械焊接、电子制造、园区安防、农业种植、车载安全十大主流行业，企业也可基于平台自主标注、训练专属行业检测模型，快速搭建轻量化、可落地的机器视觉智能管控系统。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p style="text-align: center"><strong>重磅发布 19 个视觉分析模型，涉及厂区消防安全、人员作业合规、工业设备与管线巡检、电子精密质检和农业种植监测等 10 大主流场景</strong></p>
<hr>
<p style="text-align: center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">通过网盘分享的文件(安装包和手册)：iNeuOS_Vision</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">链接: <a href="https://pan.baidu.com/s/19GrUoWXnG2fnNhesNDJ5Qg?pwd=unmy" rel="noopener nofollow">https://pan.baidu.com/s/19GrUoWXnG2fnNhesNDJ5Qg?pwd=unmy</a> 提取码: unmy</span></p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<blockquote>
<h1><span style="font-size: 18px">一、 概述</span></h1>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; <a href="http://www.ineuos.net/" rel="noopener nofollow">iNeuOS_Vision</a>·视觉分析是面向工业现场的机器视觉模型训练与应用管理平台，围绕<strong>数据标注、数据管理、模型训练、模型管理、模型测试、视觉分析和告警管理形成完整闭环</strong>。系统支持私有化部署，可用于快速构建可训练、可部署、可运营的视觉智能应用。并且深度与 iNeuOS 工业互联网操作系统集成，把视觉识别结果转化为平台数据点、告警事件和业务展示内容。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; &nbsp;基于iNeuOS_Vision平台训练的19个视觉分析模型，覆盖七大核心业务场景、横跨多实体行业：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; （1）<strong>厂区消防安全场景</strong>（火灾、烟雾、厂区违规吸烟、液体泄漏、综合工业隐患识别）；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; （2）<strong>人员作业合规监管场景</strong>（劳保 / 食品车间防护穿戴、作业玩手机打闹、司机疲劳、人员跌倒、办公坐姿规范检测）；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; （3）<strong>工业设备与管线巡检场景</strong>（油气管道缺陷、电力线路多类故障、皮带煤矸分拣、钢材表面瑕疵、焊接多维度缺陷检测）；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; （4）<strong>电子精密质检场景</strong>（PCB 电路板各类细微缺陷自动识别）；</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; （5）<strong>农业种植监测场景</strong>（农作物各类病害、虫害智能识别）。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 平台模型<strong>适配食品加工、电力运维、油气管道、钢铁冶金、矿山煤炭、机械焊接、电子制造、园区安防、农业种植、车载安全</strong>十大主流行业，企业也可基于平台自主标注、训练专属行业检测模型，快速搭建轻量化、可落地的机器视觉智能管控系统。</span></p>
<blockquote>

<blockquote>
<h1><span style="font-size: 18px">三、模型介绍</span></h1>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.1 火灾识别模型（fire.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型主要用于<strong>火灾识别</strong>检测，模型训练结束后模型精确率、召回率均逼近 0.95 级别；mAP@0.5 最终结果为 0.970，在目标检测任务中属于极高精度水准，目标框定位与类别识别的综合可靠性较强，可用于工业火灾识别场景。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093352558-1322664477.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093358975-1569346148.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093406596-781403210.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.2 烟雾识别模型（smoke.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-size: 16px"> 本模型专注于<strong>烟雾识别检测</strong>，该烟雾检测模型训练收敛稳定，整体 mAP@0.5 达到 0.740，识别综合效果优良，可应用于厂区防火、火情前置预警、安防视频烟火监测等业务场景。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093455548-867002187.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093503535-920615194.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093511757-218288031.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.3 人员吸烟识别模型（person_smoking.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于人员在各种室内外场景中<strong>吸烟行为</strong>进行检测识别，全局 mAP@0.5 达到 0.714，可识别人员厂区违规吸烟行为，适用于工厂、园区安环智能告警场景。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093545543-344781961.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093553910-1608577885.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093602052-1631895041.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.4 液体或流体泄漏识别模型（derrame.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本项目主要用于液体或流体的泄漏识别检测，模型整体 mAP@0.5 为 0.548，精确率约 60%~70%、召回率约 50%，能够实现场景内目标基础检测识别。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093636266-275541185.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093646189-1001181428.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093653618-1036189970.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.5 工业危害检测模型（industrial.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型针对<strong>化学品隐患、明火、未佩戴安全帽、烟雾、泄漏</strong>5 类安全生产场景风险识别检测，检测性能可满足现场工业安全巡检识别需求。全类别整体mAP@0.5 达到 0.697，适用于工业厂区、施工工地等场景的视觉安防智能化升级。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093727406-263195522.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093734880-1829591336.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093742621-162597047.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.6 管道缺陷识别模型（gas_pipelines.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; 本模型面向管道缺陷识别场景，针对<strong>涂层破损、管道腐蚀、管道形变、管线本体</strong>4 类管道典型钻头觅缝缺陷，完整记录训练收敛曲线与类别检测精度，适配油气长输管道、厂区管线自动化智能巡检业务场景。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093814842-1275597852.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093821022-2134751958.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093829788-1899512810.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.7 打电话识别模型（phonecall.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; &nbsp;本模型用于识别人员<strong>打电话、闲玩打闹</strong>的场景，综合 mAP@0.5 达到 0.839，适用于工地、厂区、车间等场景人员作业规范智能监管，替代人工巡检实现作业纪律自动化管控。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093905842-608453697.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093912705-1478857937.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093919103-829943638.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.8 疲劳识别模型（fatigue.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于车内驾驶员的<strong>眨眼、疲劳犯困、非疲劳正常状态</strong>状态识别，综合 mAP@0.5 达到 0.978，可用于车载驾驶监测、厂区叉车/工程车辆司机疲劳预警等安全管控场景。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093952271-1220701944.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723093958816-1614689161.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094005833-822412490.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.9 PCB板缺陷识别模型（pcb.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于印刷电路板图像的缺陷识别检测，包括<strong>孔洞缺失、鼠咬痕迹、开路、短路、尖刺、铜屑</strong>，全类别整体 mAP@0.5 达到 0.989，六类缺陷单类别 AP 值均突破 0.98，可替代传统人工目检与基础 AOI 设备，实现 PCB 板面缺陷自动化识别定位，大幅降低人工质检人力成本，提升出厂品控效率与一致性。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094114854-2055925900.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094121447-571661348.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094129557-408625571.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.10 跌倒识别模型（laying.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; 本模型针对<strong>跌倒躺卧</strong>识别性能突出，单类别 AP 达 0.995，误漏检极少。模型精确率高、误报少，核心适配养老院、居家养老、病房、工业现场、园区等以跌倒预警为主的监护场景。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094207689-1047155809.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094217539-1669158814.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094225663-122693390.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.11 焊接缺陷识别模型（welding_detect.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于工业焊接检测图像物体识别，以<strong>识别合格焊缝、不合格焊缝及特定缺陷</strong>。不良焊缝（Bad Weld）AP=0.781，满足常规焊接产线焊缝良莠识别需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094302186-1442438137.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094310947-179615912.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094317562-1466399506.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.12 焊接缺陷识别模型-精细（welding_seg.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp; &nbsp;工业检测图像用于焊接质量的分割分析，可识别<strong>焊接不良、气孔、焊接良好、钢筋、飞溅物、裂纹</strong>等缺陷。六类焊接目标识别效果均衡，其中裂纹类别 AP 最高达 0.901，合格焊缝、焊瘤也保持 0.87 以上高识别精度，气孔、飞溅、不良焊缝 AP 稳定在 0.78~0.82 区间，模型同时具备精准缺陷定位与轮廓分割能力，各类焊接缺陷识别精度均衡优异，可直接落地工业焊接产线全品类缺陷检测、轮廓量化分析商用场景。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094350668-983867501.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094400780-2048613319.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094407650-1129736013.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.13 农业病害识别模型（agricultural_disaster.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp;本模型用于检测农业病害，包括：<strong>叶斑病、蚜虫、细菌性斑点、绿毛虫、粉霉病、红蜘蛛</strong>。均衡各类病虫害检测精度，整体满足田间主流虫害识别基础落地需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094444765-1244276967.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094452175-1267412033.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094457685-247899832.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.14 钢材表面缺陷识别模型（steel_plate.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于钢材表面缺陷识别，包括<strong>褶皱、月牙形缺口、夹杂物、油污斑点、斑块、表面麻点、冲压孔洞、氧化皮压入、划痕、丝纹斑、折边褶皱、水渍斑、焊缝纹路、龟裂纹</strong>，以上为钢材冷轧板材全品类表面典型缺陷类别，涵盖成型磕碰、轧制瑕疵、杂质嵌入、油污水渍残留、焊接痕迹及应力开裂等各类工业生产中常见表面质量问题。14 类钢材缺陷识别性能分化明显，斑块、焊缝纹路、划痕、冲压孔洞等绝大多数缺陷 AP 值高于 0.9，识别效果优异，整体可满足冷轧板材主流表面缺陷自动化质检商用需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094528498-449775017.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094534026-1627692956.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094539074-718151768.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.15 皮带运输的煤和矸石识别模型（coal_gangue.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型适用于矿山皮带输送，完成<strong>煤与矸石</strong>目标检测，实时捕捉原矿物料的输送流转状态。全局 mAP@0.5 达到 0.773，其中矸石识别 AP 为 0.799、煤炭识别 AP 为 0.746，两类目标识别能力较为均衡，可适用于采矿输送场景下煤矸分选、物料流量监测等基础业务需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094611431-1645329339.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094621544-1875594742.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094627907-106159048.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.16 基础安全防护识别模型（essential_ppe.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于基础安全防护识别<strong>：人员、 佩戴安全帽、佩戴防护手套、穿着反光背心、穿着安全劳保鞋、佩戴护目镜、无对应防护装备、未佩戴安全帽、未佩戴护目镜、未佩戴防护手套、未穿着劳保鞋</strong>。整体可满足厂区安全劳保合规识别基础应用需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094707474-371900740.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094715990-1119228200.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094722406-343439131.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.17 食品工厂安全防护识别模型（food_ppe.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于食品加工厂员工的安全防护穿戴识别，包括：<strong>佩戴防护手套、佩戴发网、口罩佩戴不规范、规范佩戴口罩、未佩戴防护手套、未佩戴发网、未佩戴口罩和穿戴安全鞋</strong>，满足食品车间卫生及安全生产监管要求。整体 mAP@0.5 达到 0.842，能够满足室内食品加工车间人员穿戴合规性智能巡检需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094758272-1109941592.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094807500-1013676172.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094817104-626444389.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.18 电力基础设施故障识别模型（power_lines.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于检测电力基础设施故障巡检，<strong>罕见缺陷、避雷器绝缘击穿、避雷器老化、避雷器破损、避雷器引线断开、瓷柱绝缘子裂纹、瓷柱绝缘子破损、瓷柱绝缘子闪络、导线断股、导线绝缘皮破损、导线松股、高压导线接点发热、金具接线破损、鸟窝、异物、引线断开</strong>，整体可满足常规输电通道主流故障隐患的巡检识别需求。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094850615-1026300067.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094858021-1592847010.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723094904030-1013077959.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<h2><span style="font-size: 16px">3.19 坐姿好坏识别模型（sitting_pose.pt）</span></h2>
</blockquote>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 本模型用于识别人员坐姿，包括<strong>良好坐姿和不良坐姿</strong>，整体 mAP@0.5 达到 0.925。其中不良坐姿类别 mAP 为 0.932，良好坐姿类别 mAP 为 0.918，两类目标识别能力均衡；可精准区分规范坐姿与违规坐姿，适用于室内场景人员坐姿智能识别监管。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723095011421-1248175413.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723095021374-1104609067.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/279374/202607/279374-20260723095406336-1119310175.png" alt="3" loading="lazy"></p>
